title: ФАС торги: границы платежей, обеспечения и неизменности предмета торгов
scope: Code/isolated-model audit; no real bank requests, keys, payments, live private D1 reads or user data writes.
instructions: AGENTS.md: keep real financial/demo boundaries, do not store tokens, retain form/native-navigation guards; bank integration explicitly deferred.

current_state.server: Worker permits only /api/metrics/visit and /api/analytics/sales. D1 schema has site_users and sale_events; sale source is always demo.
current_state.payments: FasPayments offers method selection/sample receipt only: canPay=false, status=unavailable, recipientVerified=false, sampleOnly=true. No PAN/CVV, real payment link, provider request or paid entitlement.
current_state.wallet_collateral: No wallet, escrow account, reserved balance or bank confirmation exists. deposit is a displayed auction condition. commitDemoBid checks ownership/live state/money-step/local storage, not funding.
current_state.withdrawal: Client/demo guards reject seller pause/withdraw with actual bid evidence until the protected deadline, preserve original/extended expiry, and lock canonical asset/recipient identity after bids or a final result. Private and bank edit paths share the policy. Published bank prices also stay fixed before the first bid; draft/new prices remain configurable.
current_state.immutable_deadline: Existing edits preserve ends/financial terms; private anti-sniping can extend ends within 30-day maximum. There is not yet an authoritative server original-expiry/first-accepted-bid record.
current_state.scope_limit: Local persistence and private platform access are not a shared authenticated auction ledger or escrow authorization.

findings.title: Нет подтверждённого обеспечения до принятия ставки
findings.repro: Current client implementation: dist/index.html demoBidError/commitDemoBid. node tests/security-payment-boundaries.cjs verifies that there is no live payment/escrow/bid API, charge, wallet reserve or client paid-state activation. The ordinary demo bid is local simulation; it does not prove any bank funding.
findings.meaning: Do not call this a real-funded bid or invent a browser balance. Before live bidding, require an authenticated authoritative server admission/reservation backed by a configured bank product.
findings.status: External financial integration explicitly deferred; current demo remains clearly labelled.

findings.severity: P1 business-integrity gap before real trading
findings.title: Ставки привязываются к ID, но продавец мог заменить сам предмет торгов
findings.repro: Historical baseline: actual cabinet edit/category picker allowed cars → houses with unchanged lot ID/bids/price/expiry. Reproducible permanent regressions: node tests/bank-identity-lock.cjs and node tests/owner-auction-policy.cjs.
findings.user_rule: After first bid: clarifications, photos and documents allowed; the asset itself, price and auction terms remain fixed.
findings.status: Client identity policy and bank guards implemented. bank-identity-lock, bank-editor-state and owner-auction-policy PASS. This is not server enforcement for live trades.

findings.title: Карточный холд Т-Банка не покрывает обычный 30-дневный аукцион
findings.fact: Official T-Bank card docs state a hold up to7days including authorization day. The project supports auctions up to30days. Ordinary acquiring is not an escrow service.
findings.next: Discuss nominal-account/deal/billing product and legally agreed beneficiary/reservation/release model with T-Bank; obtain explicit duration/settlement/refund capabilities before enabling real bidding.

findings.title: Правила отмены должны проверяться одним серверным writer
findings.fact: Current after-bid checks are client/demo protections. LocalStorage cannot enforce the rule across browsers/users, hold funds, or establish a server-authoritative original expiry.
findings.next: Persist immutable originalExpiry, firstAcceptedBidAt, canonical version and bid history; transactionally forbid seller pause/withdraw once the first accepted bid exists while the auction is active. Auto-extension cannot be undone by a descriptive edit.

blocking_live_bid_contract: No configured/approved bank product or trusted authenticated principal => live admission denied. UI disabled state is only presentation.
Canonical auction, server clock and version must be live; seller cannot bid on own asset; expiry/step/amount and idempotency checked again in a server transaction.
Only provider-confirmed, reconciled received/reserved funds can count. A browser flag, return URL, screenshot, request acceptance or analytics row never proves funding.
Define required coverage explicitly. Funding only a deposit is not a guarantee of the full bid amount. The bank agreement must cover auction and settlement duration, including extensions.
Reserve per actor/auction/command atomically from available funds minus other reservations. Parallel bids cannot spend the same coverage twice.

Verify bank events by the supported authentication/signature procedure; deduplicate provider event IDs and commands, reconcile status via bank API, fail closed on stale/unknown/reversed/disputed status.
Seller recipient/account changes and payout authorization require authenticated server rules and verification. Do not release funds from a browser success page or seller-controlled description.
First accepted bid freezes the asset identity, price and auction terms; permit only explicit clarifications/photos/documents under the user-approved rule, with audit history.
After a final server decision, capture/release/refund according to approved bank terms with idempotent state transitions and reconciliation. No client-created real paid/sold state.

Test insufficient/unknown funds, expired/reversed hold, concurrent reservations/bids, webhook replay/out-of-order delivery, partial failures, stale quote, duplicate submit, forbidden withdrawal, expiry/extension boundaries and asset substitution before live activation.

official_sources.fact: Ordinary card payment supports single/two-stage; hold duration up to7days.
official_sources.consulted: 2026-11-14; official search result retrieved. Direct open timed out/502, not an integration test.

official_sources.fact: Nominal-account API describes beneficiaries, deposits, deals and billing; this is relevant for capability discussion, not proof of this project being approved for escrow.
Billing identifies topups and exposes virtual beneficiary balances/holds and deal-operation control. Bank warns against bypassing that billing via other withdrawal channels.
Deal validation checks deposits against configured amounts and funds on depositor virtual accounts; a status/check alone must not be treated as an atomic local bid reservation.

meaningful_regression: tests/security-payment-boundaries.cjs tests unavailable financial API routes before any D1 work; real checkout module cannot create charges/paid state/provider calls/card collection or change bids/lot state from a forged funded/paid browser flag.
not_done: Claim of complete payment safety or real escrow
non_live_enforcement_note: Rules are meaningful protections for the current demo. A malicious browser still controls its local state; live trading remains blocked by missing financial/backend capabilities, not made secure by these client checks.
